entities.title: No two players on one device
entities.summary: Two people play each other only online, each on their own device.
entities.impact: A friend in the same room needs a second device.

entities.title: Online matches don't go on the table
entities.summary: Only one-player matches against the computer can be entered.
entities.impact: An online win is not recorded anywhere.

entities.title: Online matches can't be paused
entities.summary: Esc opens a menu over an online match, which goes on.
entities.impact: A player who looks away keeps playing; a hidden tab makes the other player wait.

entities.title: Offline matches can't be entered
entities.summary: A match the server issued no seed for still plays, but cannot go on the table.
entities.impact: A player whose connection drops before the match loses the chance to enter it.
entities.workaround: Start another match once the connection is back.

entities.title: Thirty-minute replays
entities.summary: The server replays matches of up to 30 minutes, and seeds expire after 24 hours unused.
entities.impact: A longer match, or one submitted a day later, is refused.

entities.title: Plain names
entities.summary: Names are up to 12 plain characters; accents are dropped and a few letters spelled out (Þór becomes Thor).
entities.impact: Names in other scripts cannot be shown.
